hero.tagline: Art and the table, in places we only open for one night.

btoc.label: For you
btoc.text: Join one of our singular dinners: ~20 guests, an unusual venue revealed at booking, a work of art and a table in conversation.

btob.label: For your company
btob.text: Compose a bespoke event with Serge and Fany — afterwork, product launch, private evening, wedding. Our methodology, in three words: intimacy, surprise, circularity.
